channel.title: QRS News
channel.description: News from the Quantitative Research Society: research, releases, events and guides.

item.title: Upcoming: Global Market Making Games 2026 — Singapore Qualifier
item.description: An individual global market-making competition open to university students across Singapore.

item.title: GeoAFT: new project page and draft explainer
item.description: Geometric Attention Fine-Tuning now has its own project page, with an interactive geometry explorer, the controlled synthetic results and a draft explainer video.

item.title: MH3100, MH2100 and HE2003 solutions republished
item.description: Solutions for MH3100, MH2100 and HE2003 are republished in a multi-method, fully worked style.

item.title: QRS Research Academy
item.description: The QRS Research Academy takes members from guided research to independent research leadership. Applications are open from the Academy page.

item.title: IMC Tech Race @ NTU
item.description: An on-campus coding race by IMC featuring 20 rapid computer-science problems, a live leaderboard, networking with IMC technologists, and prizes.

item.title: Singapore vs Hong Kong Quant Trading Hackathon
item.description: A cross-border university quantitative-trading competition in which Singapore and Hong Kong teams built and deployed live crypto trading strategies, with city qualifiers followed by a SG-vs-HK final.

item.title: Quant & FinTech Events Guide, January 2026
item.description: Campus events, recruiting programmes, conferences and industry expos for students interested in quant and fintech.

item.title: QRS@NTU major update, December 2025
item.description: Website fixes to folders, search and ranking, and final examination papers added for over 70 SPMS and NBS courses.
